items.title: Henry Schein Stock What Changed After Its Earnings Beat
items.summary: Henry Schein reported third quarter 2026 sales of US$3,471 million and net income of US$119 million, with both basic and diluted earnings per share from continuing operations higher than a year earlier. Management confirmed full year 2026 sales growth guidance of 4.5% to 5.5%. Strong U.S. dental merchandise demand, margin-focused value creation initiatives and tariff related benefits contributed to higher adjusted earnings and an upgraded full year earnings outlook.
